cards.title: 1.1.1 Discrete vs Continuous Quantities

blocks.text: Jo cheez gin sakte ho ya naap sakte ho — woh quantity hai. Do · qisam:
Discrete (gina jata hai) · Continuous (naapa jata · hai)
Class mein students ki tadaad · Pani ka temperature
Parking mein cars · Chalti car ki speed
Fixed, alag alag values (1,2,3 — beech mein · kuch nahi)
Range ke andar koi bhi · value
Discrete = Stairs
4 · Continuous = Ramp
2 kahin bhi khare ho
Yaad rakho: Seerhi (stairs) pe sirf step 1, 2, 3 pe khare ho sakte ho
= discrete. Ramp pe kisi bhi height pe = continuous.

cards.narration: 1.1.1 Discrete vs Continuous Quantities. Jo cheez gin sakte ho ya naap sakte ho, woh quantity hai. Do qisam. Discrete (gina jata hai), Continuous (naapa jata hai). Class mein students ki tadaad, Pani ka temperature. Parking mein cars, Chalti car ki speed. Fixed, alag alag values (1,2,3, beech mein kuch nahi). Range ke andar koi bhi value. Discrete matlab Stairs. Continuous matlab Ramp. Yaad rakho. Seerhi (stairs) pe sirf step 1, 2, 3 pe khare ho sakte ho. Matlab discrete. Ramp pe kisi bhi height pe matlab continuous. Diagram mein discrete seedhiyon ki tarah hai, sirf ginte hue steps. Continuous ek ramp hai, beech ki koi bhi height.

cards.title: 1.1.2 Digital Systems

blocks.text: A digital system is an electronic system that uses only two values: 0 and 1.

headers: 0 = OFF / LOW / FALSE  ·  1 = ON / HIGH / TRUE. Ek 0 ya 1 ko bit
rows: Copy karne pe quality loss nahi
Sirf do states (0, 1) handle karni hain

cards.narration: 1.1.2 Digital Systems. Definition ka matlab yeh hai. Digital system ek electronic system hai jo sirf do values use karta hai: 0 aur 1. Table yaad karo. Columns hain: 0 matlab OFF ya LOW ya FALSE. 1 matlab ON ya HIGH ya TRUE. Ek 0 ya 1 ko bit, kehte hain, jaise light switch. Faida (Advantage). Matlab. Reliable. Noise ya interference ka asar kam. Accurate. Copy karne pe quality loss nahi. Design karna aasan hai. Sirf do states (0, 1) handle karni hain. Programmable. Software se aasani se control.

cards.title: Boolean laws & row count

blocks.text: Truth-table rows: \(2^{n}\) where \(n\) is the number of inputs. 2 inputs → 4 rows, 3 inputs → 8, 4 inputs → 16.
De Morgan: bar todo, sign badlo. NAND is \(\overline{A \cdot B} = A' + B'\). NOR is \(\overline{A + B} = A' \cdot B'\).

cards.narration: Boolean laws & row count. Yeh golden point hai, paper mein aksar aata hai. Truth-table rows: 2 ki power n jahan n inputs ki tadaad hai. 2 inputs se 4 rows, 3 inputs se 8, 4 inputs se 16. Yaad rakho. De Morgan: bar todo, sign badlo. NAND A dot B ka poora bar barabar A bar plus B bar hai. NOR A plus B ka poora bar barabar A bar dot B bar hai. Table yaad karo. Columns hain: Gate, Expression, khaas row. AND. Y barabar A dot B. Output 1 sirf tab aata hai jab dono inputs 1 hon. OR. Y barabar A plus B. Output 0 sirf tab aata hai jab dono inputs 0 hon. NOT. Y barabar A bar. Ek input ko ulta kar deta hai. NAND. Y barabar (A dot B) bar. Output 0 sirf tab aata hai jab dono inputs 1 hon. NOR. Y barabar (A plus B) bar. Output 1 sirf tab aata hai jab dono inputs 0 hon.

cards.title: 1.1.7 Logic Gates (AND, OR, NOT)

blocks.text: Logic gates are electronic circuits that perform Boolean operations. They take one or more input bits and produce one output bit.
Har digital system ki building blocks — ek processor mein arbon · (billions) gates. NOT gate ko inverter bhi kehte hain.
A · Y
AND:  \(Y = A \cdot B\)
NOT:  \(Y = A'\)
AND = "D" shape (flat back) · OR = curved back + nokeela front · NOT = triangle + bubble
Yaad rakho: Sirf "special row" yaad karo: AND = 1 sirf 11 pe. OR =
0 sirf 00 pe.
Paper mein: "Draw symbol, write expression & truth table" (2–3 marks har gate). Inputs A, B aur output Y zaroor label karo.

cards.narration: 1.1.7 Logic Gates (AND, OR, NOT). Yeh golden point hai, paper mein aksar aata hai. Definition ka matlab yeh hai. Logic gates electronic circuits hain jo Boolean operations perform karti hain. Yeh ek ya zyada input bits leti hain aur ek output bit deti hain. Har digital system ki building blocks, ek processor mein arbon. (billions) gates. NOT gate ko inverter bhi kehte hain. AND: Y barabar A dot B. NOT: Y barabar A bar. AND matlab "D" shape (flat back). OR matlab curved back + nokeela front. NOT matlab triangle + bubble. Yaad rakho. Sirf "special row" yaad karo: AND matlab 1 sirf 11 pe. OR matlab. 0 sirf 00 pe. Paper mein aise poochte hain. "Draw symbol, write expression & truth table" (2-3 marks har gate). Inputs A, B aur output Y zaroor label karo. Diagram mein AND ki shape D jaisi hai, OR dhal ki tarah, aur NOT ek triangle hai jiske aage chhota bubble hai.

cards.title: Expressions, minterms & a K-map

blocks.text: Precedence, like BODMAS: brackets, then NOT \('\), then AND \(\cdot\), then OR \(+\).
XOR is 1 when the inputs differ: \(Y = A \oplus B = A'B + AB'\). XNOR is the equality gate: \(Y = (A \oplus B)'\).
Worked K-map in the booklet: the group of four 1s is \(A'\) and the pair is \(BC\), so \(F = A' + BC\).

cards.narration: Expressions, minterms & a K-map. Yeh golden point hai, paper mein aksar aata hai. Precedence, like BODMAS: brackets, then NOT bar, then AND dot, then OR plus. XOR tab 1 hota hai jab inputs alag hon: Y barabar A xor B barabar A barB plus AB bar. XNOR equality gate hai: Y barabar (A xor B) bar. Table yaad karo. Columns hain: Minterm (SOP), Maxterm (POS). Taken from. Rows where output 1 hai. Rows where output 0 hai. Variable that 0 hai. Written with a bar, A bar. Written plain, A. Variable that 1 hai. Written plain, A. Written with a bar, A bar. Example A=B=C=1. A barBC. (A plus B bar plus C bar). Worked K-map in the booklet: the group of four 1s is A bar and the pair is BC, so F barabar A bar plus BC.

blocks.text: Bubble Sort repeatedly compares adjacent elements and swaps them if they are in the wrong order.

headers: Har pass mein sab se bari value "bulbula" ban ke aakhir tak

Yaad rakho: Bubble = parosi (j aur j+1). Descending ke liye sirf > ko < karo.

cards.title: 2.4.1 Selection Sort

blocks.text: Selection Sort repeatedly selects the smallest element from the unsorted portion and moves it to its correct position at the front.

headers: Seats aage se bharo: position K fix, uske baad har element se
compare, chhota mile to swap. Pass 1:

blocks.text: 1 8 4 9 3 1 end pass 1 ✔ 1 first for k in range(n - 1):           # fixed position · for p in range(k + 1, n):    # outer + 1 se · if d[k] > d[p]: · d[k], d[p] = d[p], d[k]
Yaad rakho: Selection: inner loop outer + 1 se shuru, compare hamesha fixed DATA[K] se. Bubble: hamesha parosi. Selection sort stable nahi.

For p in range(k + 1, n): # outer + 1 se. If d[k] > d[p]. D[k], d[p] matlab d[p], d[k]. Yaad rakho. Selection: inner loop outer + 1 se shuru, compare hamesha fixed DATA[K] se. Bubble: hamesha parosi. Selection sort stable nahi. Selection sort unsorted hisson mein sab se chhota dhoondh kar aage le aata hai.

Step · Element · == 7 ? · Result

cards.title: 2.4.2 Binary Search

blocks.text: Binary Search is an efficient search algorithm that works by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half. (List must be sorted.)
Item = DATA[MID] → found, ruko · Item < DATA[MID] → END = MID − 1 (left half) · Item > DATA[MID] → BEG = MID + 1 (right half) · Jab tak BEG ≤ END repeat; warna Not Found
DATA = 1…9, Item = 7:
BEG · END
MID=5
BEG · END
MID=7
# BEG END MID D[MID] Compare → Action
Har step pe aadhi list khatam: worst case checks — 1000 items mein sirf ~10!
Yaad rakho: Dictionary mein lafz: beech se kholo, "pehle ya baad?", aadhi kitaab phenko. "Pehle sorted, phir search."
Paper mein: Sorted list + item diya jata hai: table BEG · END · MID
· DATA[MID] · Compare · Action zaroor banao.

cards.narration: 2.4.2 Binary Search. Yeh golden point hai, paper mein aksar aata hai. Definition ka matlab yeh hai. Binary Search ek efficient search algorithm hai jo search interval ko baar baar aadha karke kaam karti hai. (List sorted hona zaroori hai.). Item matlab DATA[MID] phir found, ruko. Item < DATA[MID] phir END matlab MID − 1 (left half). Item > DATA[MID] phir BEG matlab MID + 1 (right half). Jab tak BEG ≤ END repeat; warna Not Found. DATA matlab 1…Item matlab 7. BEG, END. MID=5. BEG, END. MID=7. # BEG END MID D[MID] Compare phir Action. 2 6 9 15/2 phir 7 7 7 matlab 7 phir Found, LOC 7. Code example. Beg, end matlab 0, len(data) - 1. While beg < matlab end. Mid matlab (beg + end) double slash 2. If data[mid] barabar barabar item. Print("Found at", mid); break. Elif item < data[mid]. End matlab mid - 1. Else. Beg matlab mid + 1. Har step pe aadhi list khatam: worst case checks, 1000 items mein sirf ~10! Yaad rakho. Dictionary mein lafz: beech se kholo, "pehle ya baad?", aadhi kitaab phenko. "Pehle sorted, phir search.". Paper mein aise poochte hain. Sorted list + item diya jata hai: table BEG. END. MID. DATA[MID], Compare, Action zaroor banao.

blocks.text: while = jab tak condition True rahe, block dohrao.

exit loop
True · print(count) count += 1 count · count<=3? · Printed · After update
1 · True · 1 · 2

3 · True · 3 · 4
4 · False · — · loop ends for i in range(1, 6): · if i == 3: · break · print(i) · # Output: 1 2 for i in range(1, 6): · if i == 3: · continue · print(i) · # Output: 1 2 4 5

cards.title: 3.6 Libraries in Python

blocks.text: A library (module) is a collection of pre-written code that offers ready-made functions.
Square root khud likhne ki bajaye import math → math.sqrt(). · Faide: time bachta, bugs kam, doosron ke kaam pe khare ho.
Tareeqa · Syntax · Call kaise
1. Poora module · import math · math.sqrt(25)
2. Alias · (nickname) import math as m · m.sqrt(16)
3. Ek function · from math import sqrt · sqrt(36)
4. Kuch functions · from math import · sqrt, pi sqrt(9), pi
5. Sab kuch (*) · from math import * · sqrt(64) — · avoid
Dhoka: from math import * har naam program mein dump kar deta hai — naam takra sakte hain.

Motor, switch, auto, door, water valve, fan controller. Connectivity, Data bhejna ya lena; iske, baghair sensor baat nahi kar sakta. Wi-Fi, Bluetooth,, ZigBee, 4G/5G. Raw data phir info: collect, organise, analyse, decide. Kamra garam? Phir AC on. Data, Processing. Cloud, Computing. Internet pe. Storage ya services, IoT ka bhaari data. Google Drive, iCloud,, LMS. User, Interface. User info dekhe aur command de. Mobile app, touch screen, voice. Yaad rakho. Sensor senses (input), Actuator acts (output), lafz hi jawab hain. Paper mein aise poochte hain. "Define IoT & explain components", sab se frequent long question. Definition ke 3 ideas (physical devices, internet se connected, khud-ba-khud kaam) + 6 components + diagram. cards.title: 6.8 Steps 10–12: Analysis, Conclusion, Recommendations

blocks.text: Analyse = data ko ghaur se parh ke patterns aur trends dhoondna:
Zyada tar students (21/40
) roz 3–5 ghante phone use karte hain. · Aadhe taleemi kaam (lectures/notes) ke liye. · Trend: jo zyada entertainment ke liye use karte, un mein · distraction bohat zyada.
Conclusion formula: "The data shows … However … Therefore …"

The data shows most students use phones 3–5 hours daily. However, half use them for lectures and notes. Therefore, phones help study when used for learning, but entertainment use increases distraction.
Recommendations (har ek finding se nikle): parhai ke waqt · notifications band / focus mode; entertainment ka waqt mehdood; · teachers achhi study apps batayein.
Paper mein: "Write a conclusion and two recommendations" —
shows/however/therefore + har recommendation kisi finding se jurri ho.

cards.narration: 6.8 Steps 10-12: Analysis, Conclusion, Recommendations. Yeh golden point hai, paper mein aksar aata hai. Analyse matlab data ko ghaur se parh ke patterns aur trends dhoondna. Conclusion formula: "The data … However … Therefore …" dikhata hai. Definition ka matlab yeh hai. Data dikhata hai ke zyada tar students roz 3-5 hours phone use karte hain. Lekin aadhe unhein lectures aur notes ke liye use karte hain. Is liye phone padhai mein madad karta hai jab learning ke liye use ho, lekin entertainment wali use distraction barhati hai. Recommendations (har ek finding se nikle): parhai ke waqt. Notifications band ya focus mode; entertainment ka waqt mehdood;. Teachers achhi study apps batayein. Paper mein aise poochte hain. "Write a conclusion and two recommendations",. Shows ya however ya therefore + har recommendation kisi finding se jurri ho.
